notes: A170941.A170941count_tendsto: Tendsto (fun n => (A170941count n : R) / inv n) atTop (nhds (exp (-1))), A170941count n = #{sigma : Perm (Fin n) | sigma*sigma = 1, no i with sigma i = i+1}, inv = A000085. Limit: desc_bound (term <= 1/k!), E_tendsto, Tannery. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (reading: 'no adjacent transposition' formalised as no i with sigma i = i+1).
